new_candidates.body:
### Ticket Type

Bug report

### Description

Saving and reloading a pipeline containing `RewardClassifierProcessorStep(pretrained_path=...)` silently disables reward classification. Its configuration omits `pretrained_path`, so the reloaded step has no classifier and passes rewards and termination flags through unchanged.

### Context & Reproduction

Construct a `DataProcessorPipeline` containing a reward classifier step, save it with `save_pretrained`, then reload with `from_pretrained` without overrides. The saved step config contains the device, thresholds and reward settings but no classifier checkpoint. The original step calls the classifier; the restored one returns before inference because `reward_classifier is None`.

A CPU regression with a stubbed checkpoint loader gives reward 2 and `done=True` before saving, but reward 0 and `done=False` after reload. Explicitly overriding `pretrained_path` at load time works around it.

### Expected behavior

Preserve the configured classifier checkpoint in the serialized step configuration. Pipelines saved before this correction still need an explicit `pretrained_path` override because they contain no checkpoint reference.
new_candidates.title: fix(processor): reloading a reward pipeline loses its classifier checkpoint
